name: SAB Recruitment 2026
description: Join our student community to organize campus events, build multimedia campaigns, and support student life.
instructions: Submit one application per position with a PDF CV (max 5 MB), a motivation statement (max 300 words), and your interview slot availability.

positions.title: Content Team Specialist
positions.description: Write engaging social media posts, press copy, and campaign narratives.
positions.requirements: Strong copywriting skills and familiarity with student communication channels.

positions.title: Communications Coordinator
positions.description: Coordinate external outreach, partner messaging, and event PR.
positions.requirements: Clear verbal communication and stakeholder coordination skills.

positions.title: Design & Media Specialist
positions.description: Produce event posters, stage visuals, and digital flyers.
positions.requirements: Proficiency in Figma or Adobe Creative Suite and basic visual design portfolio.

positions.title: Event Operations Coordinator
positions.description: Support on-ground logistics, venue booking coordination, and stage management.
positions.requirements: Teamwork, problem-solving under pressure, and event coordination experience.
